findings.description: target_markets includes 'EUU', which is not a valid market code (compliance.standards_map check profile.target_markets_valid fails; valid codes are CA, EU, UK, US). Likely a typo of 'EU'; an unrecognised code maps no standards at all.

requirements/requirements.md REQ-ELEC-002 names Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), but profile.radios only lists wifi_2g4 and radar_60ghz (check radios.requirements_named_radio_missing fails: bluetooth). Add a bluetooth radio id (e.g. ble) to radios, or add a [radios_excluded] note if BLE was ruled out.

profile.radios lists radar_60ghz but no requirement or params.toml entry names a radar (check radios.profile_radio_untraced fails: radar). Either add a requirement for the radar, or remove it from radios if the product has none.

measurements.name: profile.target_markets_valid
measurements.remediation: target_markets has unknown code(s) ['EUU']; valid codes are ['CA', 'EU', 'UK', 'US'] (aliases: ['GB']), from standards.toml [[market]]. An unknown code maps no standards at all. Fix the typo, or add the market with sourced rows first.

measurements.name: radios.requirements_named_radio_missing
measurements.remediation: the project names radio(s) the profile does not list: bluetooth (first named at requirements/requirements.md:9). Add the matching id(s) from ['ble', 'ieee802154_2g4', 'radar_60ghz', 'wifi_2g4'] to radios (and has_radio = true), or add [radios_excluded] bluetooth = "<why>".

measurements.name: radios.profile_radio_untraced
measurements.remediation: the profile lists radio famil(ies) ['radar'] that no requirements/**/*.md or params/params.toml text names. Either the requirements are missing that radio, or the profile claims a radio the product does not have (remove it).

bad-no-findings.why: a missing findings file fails every file-target grader, including the not_contains decoy grader and the out/verify status check (nothing was ever run)

bad-check-not-run.why: the agent guessed the defects by reading the files instead of actually running mapping-compliance's own check -- proves compliance-check-genuinely-fails is not vacuous: it fails whenever the real check was never run, regardless of what the findings say

bad-edited-profile.why: this is a review, not a fix -- editing the profile under review must fail no-profile-edits even though the findings themselves might still be fine
